notes: Actual PETSc build + run (PETSC_ARCH=arch-kokkos-dbg, OpenMPI, 4 ranks, CG + GAMG). Convergence: observed orders 2.00 in both L2 and Linf (errors quarter per h-halving) => second order confirmed. In-situ NaN/Inf check on the 129x129 solution passed (||u||_2 = 6.400321e+01; boundary residual ~1e-11, center u=1.00005 vs exact 1.0, max pointwise error 5.02e-5). SOLUTION OUTPUT FORMAT NOTE: the vis-spec requested HDF5+XDMF, but this PETSc build was configured WITHOUT HDF5 (no PETSC_HAVE_HDF5, no hdf5 lib in arch-kokkos-dbg), so PetscViewerHDF5Open is unavailable. To honor the XDMF request without an env change, code-generation writes an XDMF 2.0 wrapper (uniform 2DCoRectMesh) over headerless raw little-endian double field dumps (poisson_solution_u.bin, poisson_solution_u_exact.bin, poisson_solution_error.bin), which ParaView opens directly; a native VTK poisson_solution.vts (u, u_exact, error) is also emitted as a robust companion. Both carry the three fields the warp/mesh/error renders need. If true .h5 output is required, the orchestrator should rebuild PETSc with --download-hdf5 (environment change, not a code fix). poisson.c changes: added CheckNanInf (in-situ), FillExactAndError (pointwise |u_h-u_exact|), WriteFieldBinary (parallel gather to natural order on rank 0), WriteXDMF, OutputSolve, and -out_grid/-out_prefix options; convergence loop skipped when -mms_levels 0.
